evidence.title: User Experience at Flam | Ritesh Bucha

name: Ritesh Bucha
summary: Personal site that doubles as a shadcn registry of 26 craft components for Next.js apps.
description: Portfolio of Ritesh Bucha with a shadcn registry called Craft. Components — text highlight, split text effect, liquid-metal WebGL button, modern progress, book, game of life, magical mouse, view magnifier, pixel icon, icon maker — install into Next.js apps with next-themes and Tailwind CSS (system, light and dark modes). The site also carries a portfolio, experience notes, bookmarks and a guestbook.
